The mistake was not corrected later and the final answer (Step 45) indeed used an unsupported estimate, so the error contributed directly to the wrong outcome.

Sound. The log shows that up to Step 29 all agents were still attempting to obtain actual June 2020–2023 data. This directly relates to the eventual incorrect outcome (a guessed 60% at Step 45) and was not subsequently corrected; later steps continued to struggle with data access and even proposed synthetic data (Step 44), culminating in a non-data-based answer. No earlier step explicitly abandoned data collection, so Step 30 is the first mistake tied to the final wrong result.

The final response at Step 45 delivers a 60% estimate explicitly citing data access issues, confirming the estimation approach was never reversed or corrected.
